name: Osaka
tagline: Takoyaki since 1972 in Dotonbori, and the Bib Gourmand okonomiyaki that always has a line.

Honke Ootako.description: Generous octopus balls since 1972, mentioned in the Michelin Guide, right in Dotonbori.

Kiji.description: Okonomiyaki with a constant line in Umeda, recognized with a Bib Gourmand.

Okonomiyaki Mizuno.description: One of Osaka's most acclaimed okonomiyaki spots, traditional griddle style.

Kani Doraku Dotonbori Honten.description: Osaka's most iconic crab restaurant, recognizable by the giant 6-meter mechanical crab on its Dotonbori facade.

Genrokuzushi.description: The spot that invented conveyor-belt sushi (kaiten-zushi) in 1958, an invention born in Osaka.
